section: Tampa International Airport SkyCenter One: Microsoft Teams spaces, hot desking app and video wall boardroom
body:
Tampa International Airport used an office relocation to SkyCenter One to set up a hybrid work environment with collaboration areas and hot desking. AVI-SPL integrated the meeting and workplace technology across all three floors and now supports it through its managed services team.

**Goals and hurdles**
- The main objective was new technology that is simple to use and gives a consistent, positive user experience.
- Post-pandemic product availability caused delays; AVI-SPL adjusted the schedule to move other parts of the project forward and completed it in line with the customer's technology preferences.
- Security was another hurdle. AVI-SPL worked with airport personnel to reach offices that need an employee badge or an escort.

**What was integrated**
- Video conferencing equipment, a hot desking app, displays, cameras, microphones, video bars, control panels, a content-sharing system, mice and keyboards.
- Technology standards: Microsoft Teams, Crestron Mercury and Flex control panels, Barco ClickShare, Logitech and Huddly cameras, NanoLumens video walls, and Samsung and LG displays.
- Rooms have Shure microphones and Crestron speakers.
- Crestron scheduling panels were installed outside the conference rooms so employees can see availability and book space for impromptu sessions.
- Boardroom: a flexible space with moveable furniture. Its centerpiece is a NanoLumens LED video wall given on the page as 11.81 x 6.64 (no unit stated), together with several 98" Samsung displays and a 65" display on the ceiling.
- "Porches" where employees gather and take breaks each have a digital signage display driven by a BrightSign media player, showing content such as employee anniversaries, wellness ideas and menus.

**Hot desking app and content management by 22Miles**
- AVI-SPL brought in 22Miles to help deliver a content management system and a hot desking app.
- Employees can reserve a desk in the app, in Outlook, or onsite with their badge at a desk.
- The app has 3-D wayfinding with real-time turn-by-turn directions.
- With Microsoft Office 365 integration, the app can also find co-workers, reserve meeting spaces, schedule Teams meetings and invite participants, and alert maintenance to issues. Managers can view space utilization stats.

**Impact as stated**
- AVI-SPL worked with the airport authority and the general contractor. The page says the updated offices and conference rooms created a productive hybrid work environment.
- Employees can reserve a desk in advance, find space near coworkers or choose a quiet spot. Team members find the video conferencing equipment easy to use and consistent across SkyCenter.
- The technology is kept up to date by AVI-SPL's managed services team. According to the page, on-call support and proactive maintenance keep support tickets down and lighten the load on internal IT.
- AVI-SPL says it looks forward to supporting the next phase.

**When to use this**
For questions about hot desking, wayfinding, scheduling panels or a Microsoft Teams office fit-out in a secure site.

**Not stated in this source**
No room counts, costs, timelines or ticket figures.
